title: Santa Monica is now home to the world’s first-ever Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Pizzeria
description:
Thousands of fans turned out for the grand opening on the Third Street Promenade, where they were greeted by the turtles themselves.

Head to the Promenade and try a slice for yourself.

📍1444 Third Street Promenade
transcript_text: How a bunga, the teenage mutant ninja turtles pizzeria is now open on the third street promenade in Santa Monica. Thousands of fans showed up for the grand opening and the line was [music] absolutely packed from start to finish. Fans were greeted by Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael who came out to meet the crowd and celebrate the big day. Turtle fans, this is your chance to experience the first ever TMNT pizzeria. So head over to the promenade and grab a slice for yourself.
